text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing— Grass 
Wonder suddenly stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Isn't that over there—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, this and that too... Every single 
one is wicked pretty, yeah~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe-chaaan. What're you lookin' at~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Grass-chan! ...And her Trainer, too. 
Good evening!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The kimonos lined up in that shop are so 
pretty! Look, look~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, how truly wonderful... Every kimono 
seems to be made from famous fine woven 
fabric~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"J-Jou... fu...? Anyway, that's really 
amazing!"
choice_data_list:
You're pretty knowledgeable, aren't you, 
Grass?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I've really only dabbled in it a 
little~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice. If it's Grass-chan, it feels 
like she's already worn a kimono like that 
before~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The only time I ever wore something like 
this was for Shichi-Go-San. Mom picked it 
out for me, and—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm quite envious of Spe-chan. I never 
got to experience the Shichi-Go-San shrine 
visit, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, right. Because you were in 
America...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Over there, I was about the only one 
who owned her own kimono, so—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Standing side by side in kimonos with 
girls my age... is something I've kind 
of... always dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Keeping her usual gentle smile, Grass 
Wonder gazes into the display window—
choice_data_list: Why don't we try it on together now?
How about everyone races in kimonos?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Um. Right now?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, look! Grass-chan! It says 
"Fitting Available" right here~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"My. Oh my, oh my... Hehe. Oh, Trainer, 
you really are something."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...May we take a small detour?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Hehe, I wonder which 
one I should wear...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder looked like she was having a 
lot of fun trying on kimonos alongside 
Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—My, my, fufu. That sounds like so much 
fun~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? W-What do I do! I can't put on a 
kimono all by myself...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Spe-chan. I'll be right there 
to help you out♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you're wearing one too, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. So someday, let us go pick 
out a kimono together.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Fufufu. I wonder what kind of thing would 
suit them...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder seemed to be having a great 
deal of fun that day.
